issues.detail: The Hebrew has 'עִיר שָׁמֶשׁ' (Ir-shemesh, meaning 'City of the Sun'), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Y-rơ-sa-mết', which is a different name (likely a confusion with 'Jarmuth' or a misreading). The correct transliteration should be 'Y-rơ-sê-mết' or 'Thành Sê-mết' (City of Shemesh), not 'Y-rơ-sa-mết'.
